others.text: Liebermann (description of S) took it for a copy of S and did not use it.

O’Brien (God’s Peace and King’s Peace, 1999, 141; Anglo-Norman Studies 25, 2003) shows it to be an independent witness to the Instituta Cnuti: a 16th-century transcript, probably of the same lost manuscript as College of Arms Vincent 98, descending with Pl from the lost π. In his family tree it is ‘Ha’.
